records.literal_gloss: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to YHWH concerning [the] words of Cush, a Benjaminite.

en.L: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} concerning [the] words of Cush, a Benjaminite.
en.B: A shiggaion of David, which he sang to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} about Cush, a man of the tribe of Benjamin.
en.R: A song of David. He sang it to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} because of what Cush, from the tribe of Benjamin, said.

fr.L: Un shiggayon de David, qu’il chanta {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} au sujet des paroles de Koush, un Benjaminite.
fr.B: Un shiggayon de David, qu’il chanta {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} au sujet de Koush, un homme de la tribu de Benjamin.
fr.R: Un chant de David. Il l’a chanté {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} à cause de ce qu’avait dit Koush, de la tribu de Benjamin.

sw.L: Shigayoni ya Daudi, aliyomwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu maneno ya Kushi, Mbenyamini.
sw.B: Shigayoni ya Daudi, aliyomwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kuhusu Kushi, mtu wa kabila la Benyamini.
sw.R: Wimbo wa Daudi. Alimwimbia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa sababu ya maneno aliyosema Kushi, wa kabila la Benyamini.

es.L: Sigayón de David, que cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} acerca de [las] palabras de Cus, benjamita.
es.B: Sigayón de David, que él cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} acerca de Cus, un hombre de la tribu de Benjamín.
es.R: Canto de David. Se lo cantó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} por lo que había dicho Cus, de la tribu de Benjamín.

vi.L: [Một] bài Si-ga-giôn của Đa-vít, mà ông đã hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về những lời của Cút, người Bên-gia-min.
vi.B: Bài Si-ga-giôn của Đa-vít, ông hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} về Cút, người thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min.
vi.R: Bài ca của Đa-vít. Ông hát bài này cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vì những gì Cút, người thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min, đã nói.

ko.L: 다윗의 식가욘. 그가 베냐민 사람 구스의 말에 대해 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부른 것.
ko.B: 다윗의 식가욘. 베냐민 지파 사람 구스의 일로 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부른 노래.
ko.R: 다윗이 지은 노래. 베냐민 지파 사람 구스가 한 말 때문에 다윗이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부른 노래이다.

pt.L: Sigaiom de Davi, que ele cantou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a respeito das palavras de Cuxe, um benjamita.
pt.B: Sigaiom de Davi, que ele cantou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a respeito de Cuxe, homem da tribo de Benjamim.
pt.R: Canção de Davi. Ele a cantou {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} por causa do que disse Cuxe, da tribo de Benjamim.

am.L: የዳዊት ሽጋዮን፤ ስለ ብንያማዊው ስለ ኩሽ ቃል {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የዘመረው።
am.B: የዳዊት ሽጋዮን፤ ከብንያም ነገድ ስለ ሆነው ስለ ኩሽ {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} የዘመረው።
am.R: ዳዊት የዘመረው መዝሙር፤ ከብንያም ነገድ የሆነው ኩሽ በተናገረው ነገር ምክንያት {{divine_name:ለእግዚአብሔር|ለያህዌ}} ዘመረው።

hi.L: दाऊद का शिग्गायोन, जिसे उसने बिन्यामीनी कूश की बातों के विषय में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाया।
hi.B: दाऊद का शिग्गायोन, जिसे उसने बिन्यामीन गोत्र के एक व्यक्ति कूश के विषय में {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए गाया।
hi.R: दाऊद का गीत। उसने इसे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} के लिए उन बातों के कारण गाया जो बिन्यामीन गोत्र के कूश ने कही थीं।

ru.L: Шиггайон Давида, который он пел {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} по поводу слов Куша, вениамитянина.
ru.B: Шиггайон Давида, который он пел {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} о Куше, человеке из колена Вениамина.
ru.R: Песнь Давида. Он пел её {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Яхве}} из-за того, что сказал Куш из колена Вениамина.

ja.L: ダビデのシガヨン。ベニヤミン人クシュの言葉について、彼が{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌ったもの。
ja.B: ダビデのシガヨン。ベニヤミン族の人クシュのことで、ダビデが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌ったもの。
ja.R: ダビデの歌。ベニヤミン族のクシュが言ったことについて、ダビデはこの歌を{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}に歌った。

uk.L: Шіґґайон Давида, який він співав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} щодо слів Куша, веніяминівця.
uk.B: Шіґґайон Давида, який він співав {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} про Куша, чоловіка з племені Веніямина.
uk.R: Пісня Давида. Він співав її {{divine_name:ГОСПОДУ|Ягве}} через те, що сказав Куш із племені Веніямина.

decisions.choice: The title is verse 1
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 3, the title is part of the Hebrew text and is counted as verse 1, so the verse numbers here are one higher than in Bibles that print the title without a number.

decisions.choice: shiggaion: a kind of song whose sense is unknown
alternatives: a song of wandering or excitement
decisions.reason: The word (shiggayon) is used only here and, in the plural, in Habakkuk 3:1. It names a kind of song; some link it with a verb for wandering or reeling, others with a word for lament. Literal and Balanced keep it.

decisions.choice: the words of Cush, a Benjaminite: an enemy not otherwise known
decisions.reason: No Cush of Benjamin appears elsewhere in Scripture. Saul was a Benjaminite, and so was Shimei, who cursed David (2 Samuel 16:5-8), so Cush was probably one of Saul's supporters who slandered David. "The words of Cush" may mean what he said, or simply "the matter of Cush".

decisions.choice: A song
decisions.reason: Readable says only that it is a song, since the exact sense is unknown (m1).

decisions.choice: "shiggayon" kept as a name (Literal, Balanced), "Un chant" at Readable; "Koush" for the man's name
decisions.reason: The kind of song the word names is unknown (m2), so French keeps it as the English does, in the spelling of the terms note. The name Cush is written "Koush" so that French readers say it as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "Shigayoni" kept as a name at Literal and Balanced; "Wimbo" (a song) at Readable
decisions.reason: What kind of song a shiggaion was is not known (m2). Literal and Balanced keep the Hebrew word in a Swahili form, as the English keeps it; Readable says only that it is a song.

decisions.choice: Sigayón
decisions.reason: The Hebrew shiggaion names a kind of song whose exact sense is no longer known. Literal and Balanced keep the word in its Spanish form, "sigayón"; Readable says "Canto", as the English Readable says "A song".

decisions.choice: "bài Si-ga-giôn" (L, B); "Bài ca" (R)
decisions.reason: No one knows what kind of song a shiggaion was (see the meaning decision), so Literal and Balanced keep the word as a name, in the form the terms note sets; Readable says only that it is a song, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "식가욘" kept as a name (L, B); "노래" at Readable; Cush is "구스"
decisions.reason: The kind of song meant is unknown (meaning decision m2); Korean keeps the word as a name, as the English keeps "shiggaion", and says only "song" at Readable, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Sigaiom (L, B); Canção (R); Cuxe
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the name of this kind of song (m2) is kept at Literal and Balanced in a Portuguese spelling, "Sigaiom", as Habakkuk 3:1 will have it; Readable says only that it is a song, as the English does. The man's name is written "Cuxe", as Brazilian Bibles spell it.

decisions.choice: shiggaion as "ሽጋዮን", a name; Readable says "መዝሙር" (song), as the English; Cush "ኩሽ", a Benjaminite "ብንያማዊ"
decisions.reason: The terms list keeps the heading word as a name, since its sense is unknown (meaning decision m2).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this psalm.
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change in Amharic; pronouns for God are written plainly.

The kind of song meant by shiggaion is unknown (meaning m2); Literal and Balanced keep the word in the form the poetry note gives, Readable says only "song", as the English does. Cush is transcribed from the Hebrew; "बिन्यामीनी" and "बिन्यामीन गोत्र" as in 1-2 Samuel.

decisions.choice: шиггайон (L, B); Песнь (R); Куш
decisions.reason: Shiggaion is a kind of song whose sense is unknown (m2): Literal and Balanced keep the word in the form the Psalms terms note gives, and Readable says only that it is a song, "Песнь", the Readable word of the other titles (mizmor, miktam), as the English does. Cush, an enemy not otherwise known (m3), is transcribed from the Hebrew; "вениамитянин" and "из колена Вениамина" are the forms of Judges and Samuel.

decisions.choice: shiggayon "シガヨン" (L, B), "歌" (R); Kush ben-Yemini "ベニヤミン人クシュ" (L), "ベニヤミン族の人クシュ" (B), "ベニヤミン族のクシュ" (R); for the Psalter, miktam "ミクタム" and maskil "マスキル" alike
decisions.reason: The kind of song is unknown (m2), so it is transliterated where the English transliterates it, and Readable says 歌 as the English Readable does. Cush is not otherwise known (m3).

decisions.choice: "Шіґґайон" transcribed, as the English keeps "shiggaion"
decisions.reason: The kind of song the word names is unknown; Readable calls it a song, as the English does.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי בְּךָ֣ חָסִ֑יתִי הוֹשִׁיעֵ֥נִי מִכָּל־רֹ֝דְפַ֗י וְהַצִּילֵֽנִי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH my God, in you I have taken refuge; save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, in {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} I have taken refuge; \q save me from all my pursuers and deliver me,
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I have made {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} my refuge. \q Save me from all who are hunting me down, and rescue me,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, I have come to {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} for safety. \q Save me from all the people who are chasing me. Rescue me!

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, en {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} je me suis réfugié ; \q sauve-moi de tous mes poursuivants et délivre-moi,
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, j’ai fait de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} mon refuge. \q Sauve-moi de tous ceux qui me traquent, et délivre-moi,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, je suis venu me mettre à l’abri auprès de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Sauve-moi de tous ceux qui me poursuivent. Délivre-moi !

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} nimekimbilia; uniokoe kutoka kwa wote wanaonifuatia na kunitoa,
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nimekufanya {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} kuwa kimbilio langu. Uniokoe kutoka kwa wote wanaoniwinda, na kunitoa mikononi mwao,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, nimekuja {{deity_pronoun:kwako|Kwako}} ili nipate usalama. Uniokoe kutoka kwa watu wote wanaonifukuza. Unitoe mikononi mwao!

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, en {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} me he refugiado; \q sálvame de todos mis perseguidores y líbrame,
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, he hecho de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} mi refugio. \q Sálvame de todos los que me persiguen para darme caza, y rescátame,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, he venido a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} para estar a salvo. \q Sálvame de toda la gente que me persigue. ¡Rescátame!

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi đã nương náu nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin cứu tôi khỏi mọi kẻ đuổi theo tôi và giải thoát tôi,
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi đã lấy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm nơi ẩn náu. Xin cứu tôi khỏi mọi kẻ đang săn đuổi tôi, và giải thoát tôi,
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, tôi đã chạy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} để được an toàn. Xin cứu tôi khỏi tất cả những kẻ đang đuổi theo tôi. Xin giải cứu tôi!

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 주님께 피하였으니, 저를 뒤쫓는 모든 자에게서 저를 구원하시고 저를 건져 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 주님을 피난처로 삼았습니다. 저를 사냥하듯 쫓는 모든 자에게서 저를 구원하시고 건져 주십시오.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 안전을 찾아 주님께 왔습니다. 저를 쫓아오는 모든 사람에게서 저를 구해 주십시오. 저를 건져 주십시오!

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, em {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} tomei refúgio; \q salva-me de todos os meus perseguidores e resgata-me,
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, eu fiz de {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} o meu refúgio. \q Salva-me de todos os que estão me caçando e livra-me,
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, eu vim a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}} em busca de proteção. \q Salva-me de todas as pessoas que estão me perseguindo. Livra-me!

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ በአንተ ተጠለልኩ፤ ከሚያሳድዱኝ ሁሉ አድነኝ፤ ታደገኝም፣
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ አንተን መጠጊያዬ አድርጌአለሁ። ከሚያሳድዱኝ ሁሉ አድነኝ፤ ታደገኝም፤
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ለደኅንነት ወደ አንተ መጥቻለሁ። ከሚያሳድዱኝ ሰዎች ሁሉ አድነኝ። ታደገኝ!

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर, मैंने तुझमें शरण ली है; मेरा पीछा करनेवाले सब लोगों से मुझे बचा और मुझे छुड़ा,
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर, मैंने तुझे अपना शरणस्थान बनाया है। जो मेरा शिकार करने को पीछे पड़े हैं, उन सबसे मुझे बचा, और मुझे छुड़ा,
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर, मैं सुरक्षा के लिए तेरे पास आया हूँ। उन सब लोगों से मुझे बचा जो मेरा पीछा कर रहे हैं। मुझे छुड़ा!

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже мой, в {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} я укрылся; спаси меня от всех преследующих меня и вызволи меня,
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, я сделал {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}} своим прибежищем. Спаси меня от всех, кто охотится за мной, и избавь меня,
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, я пришёл к {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} искать защиты. Спаси меня от всех, кто гонится за мной. Выручи меня!

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの神よ、あなたにわたしは身を避けた。わたしを追うすべての者からわたしを救い、助け出してください、
ja.B: わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしはあなたを避け所とした。わたしを追い詰めるすべての者から、わたしを救い、助け出してください。
ja.R: わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしは、あなたのもとに逃げ込んだ。わたしを追いかけて来るすべての人から、わたしを救ってください。助け出してください！

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, у {{deity_pronoun:тобі|Тобі}} я шукаю притулку; спаси мене від усіх, хто мене переслідує, і визволи мене,
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, я зробив {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} своїм притулком. Спаси мене від усіх, хто полює на мене, і врятуй мене,
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, я прибіг до {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}} по захист. Спаси мене від усіх людей, які женуться за мною. Врятуй мене!

decisions.choice: I have taken refuge: I have run to you for shelter
decisions.reason: The verb (chasah) is the one of 2:12 and 5:12. The psalmist has already fled to the LORD; now he asks for rescue.

decisions.choice: deliver me, / or he will tear: one sentence across two verses
decisions.reason: The request runs on into verse 3 ("or he will tear me"), so this verse ends with a comma.

decisions.choice: who are hunting me down (B); who are chasing me (R)
decisions.reason: The verb (radaf) is to chase or hunt; Balanced and Readable turn the noun into a clause.

decisions.choice: "nương náu nơi Ngài" (L); "lấy Ngài làm nơi ẩn náu" (B); "chạy đến với Ngài để được an toàn" (R)
alternatives: "trú ẩn nơi Ngài" at every level
decisions.reason: Taking refuge is running to someone for shelter (see the meaning decision). Each level keeps one way of saying it through the psalms of this block, as at 2:12; "nơi ẩn náu" is the terms note's word for "refuge".

decisions.choice: Verse 2 ends as a full sentence and verse 3 begins "그렇지 않으면" (or else)
alternatives: one sentence running across the verse boundary, as the English
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sentence runs on into verse 3 (meaning decision m2). Korean would have to put verse 3's clause before the verb of verse 2, so it closes the request here and starts verse 3 with a linking word, keeping each verse's content after its number.

decisions.choice: "तुझमें शरण ली है" (L); "तुझे अपना शरणस्थान बनाया है" (B); "सुरक्षा के लिए तेरे पास आया हूँ" (R)
decisions.reason: Taking refuge (chasah) is rendered at each level as at 2:12, with "शरणस्थान" for refuge, as the poetry note settles.

decisions.choice: Literal ends 7:2 with 、 and 7:3 opens さもないと, so the one sentence runs across the two verses as in the English Literal; Balanced closes 7:2 and starts 7:3 anew
decisions.reason: A Japanese verb-final sentence over two verse numbers would have to move content; the request comes first and the reason ("or he will tear") follows in its own verse.

source.text: פֶּן־יִטְרֹ֣ף כְּאַרְיֵ֣ה נַפְשִׁ֑י פֹּ֝רֵ֗ק וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: lest he tear like a lion my soul, ripping, and there is no one delivering.

en.L: lest he tear my soul like a lion, ripping [it], \q and there is no one to deliver.
en.B: or he will tear me apart like a lion, \q dragging me off with no one to rescue me.
en.R: If {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} do not, my enemy will attack me like a lion. \q He will tear me to pieces, and no one will save me.

fr.L: de peur qu’il ne déchire mon âme comme un lion, \q en [la] mettant en pièces, sans personne pour délivrer.
fr.B: sinon il me déchirera comme un lion et m’emportera, \q sans personne pour me sauver.
fr.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ne le fais pas, mon ennemi m’attaquera comme un lion. \q Il me mettra en pièces, et personne ne me sauvera.

sw.L: asije akairarua nafsi yangu kama simba, akiipasua, wala hakuna wa kuokoa.
sw.B: la sivyo atanirarua kama simba, akinikokota bila mtu wa kuniokoa.
sw.R: Usipofanya hivyo, adui yangu atanishambulia kama simba. Atanirarua vipande vipande, wala hakuna atakayeniokoa.

es.L: no sea que como un león despedace mi alma, \q arrastrándola, y no haya quien [la] libre.
es.B: o me despedazará como un león \q y me arrastrará sin que nadie me rescate.
es.R: Si {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} no lo haces, mi enemigo me atacará como un león. \q Me hará pedazos, y nadie me salvará.

vi.L: kẻo nó xé linh hồn tôi như sư tử, cắn xé [nó], mà không có ai giải cứu.
vi.B: kẻo nó xé xác tôi như sư tử, tha tôi đi mà không ai cứu tôi.
vi.R: Nếu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} không cứu, kẻ thù sẽ tấn công tôi như sư tử. Nó sẽ xé tôi ra từng mảnh, và không ai cứu được tôi.

ko.L: 그렇지 않으면 그가 사자처럼 제 영혼을 찢어 물어 갈 것이고, 건져 줄 이가 없을 것입니다.
ko.B: 그렇지 않으면 그가 사자처럼 저를 찢어 끌고 갈 것이고, 저를 건져 줄 사람이 아무도 없을 것입니다.
ko.R: 주님께서 그렇게 하지 않으시면 제 원수가 사자처럼 저를 덮칠 것입니다. 그가 저를 갈기갈기 찢어도 아무도 저를 구해 주지 못할 것입니다.

pt.L: para que ele não rasgue a minha alma como um leão, \q arrancando [pedaços], e não haja quem livre.
pt.B: senão ele me despedaçará como um leão e me arrastará, \q sem ninguém para me livrar.
pt.R: Se {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} não fizeres isso, o meu inimigo vai me atacar como um leão. \q Ele vai me fazer em pedaços, e ninguém vai me salvar.

am.L: አለዚያ እንደ አንበሳ ነፍሴን ይቦጭቃል፤ ይገነጣጥላልም፤ የሚታደግም የለም።
am.B: ያለዚያ እንደ አንበሳ ይገነጣጥለኛል፤ የሚታደገኝ ሳይኖር ጎትቶ ይወስደኛል።
am.R: ይህን ባታደርግ ጠላቴ እንደ አንበሳ ያጠቃኛል። ይገነጣጥለኛል፤ የሚያድነኝም አይኖርም።

hi.L: कहीं ऐसा न हो कि वह सिंह की तरह मेरे प्राण को फाड़ डाले, [उसे] चीरता हुआ, और कोई छुड़ानेवाला न हो।
hi.B: नहीं तो वह सिंह की तरह मुझे फाड़ डालेगा, मुझे घसीट ले जाएगा, और कोई मुझे छुड़ानेवाला न होगा।
hi.R: अगर तू ऐसा नहीं करेगा, तो मेरा दुश्मन सिंह की तरह मुझ पर टूट पड़ेगा। वह मुझे फाड़कर टुकड़े-टुकड़े कर देगा, और कोई मुझे नहीं बचाएगा।

ru.L: иначе он, как лев, растерзает мою душу, уволакивая [её], и некому избавить.
ru.B: иначе он растерзает меня, как лев, и утащит, и никто меня не спасёт.
ru.R: Если {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} не поможешь, мой враг нападёт на меня, как лев. Он разорвёт меня на куски, и никто меня не спасёт.

ja.L: さもないと、彼は獅子のようにわたしの魂を引き裂き、かみ砕いても、救い出す者はいない。
ja.B: さもないと、敵は獅子のようにわたしを引き裂き、連れ去っても、助け出してくれる者はだれもいない。
ja.R: そうしてくださらなければ、敵はライオンのようにわたしに襲いかかる。わたしを引き裂いても、だれも救ってくれない。

uk.L: щоб він не розірвав мою душу, як лев, шматуючи [її], і нема кому визволити.
uk.B: бо інакше він роздере мене, як лев, і потягне геть, і ніхто мене не врятує.
uk.R: Якщо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} цього не зробиш, мій ворог накинеться на мене, як лев. Він розірве мене на шматки, і ніхто мене не врятує.

decisions.choice: he: the enemy, one of the pursuers
decisions.reason: The verb is singular: the chief enemy, perhaps Cush of the title, is pictured as a lion.

decisions.choice: like a lion, ripping: a lion carrying off its prey
decisions.reason: Lions still lived in the land (1 Samuel 17:34-35). The picture is of prey dragged away where no shepherd can save it.

decisions.choice: my soul: me, my life
decisions.reason: The soul (nefesh) is the whole living person.

decisions.choice: If you do not, my enemy
decisions.reason: Readable starts a new sentence and names the enemy (m1).

decisions.choice: "nó" for the enemy
decisions.reason: The enemy is pictured as a beast of prey; "nó" is the plain word for an animal and for a hated foe, and fits both.

decisions.choice: 'aryeh "獅子" (L, B), "ライオン" (R), as Job and Lamentations
decisions.reason: One word for the lion through the poetry books.

source.text: יְהוָ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהַי אִם־עָשִׂ֣יתִי זֹ֑את אִֽם־יֶשׁ־עָ֥וֶל בְּכַפָּֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH my God, if I have done this, if there is wrong in my palms,

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, if I have done this, \q if there is injustice in my palms,
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, if I have done what they say, \q if my hands are guilty of wrong,
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}} my God, maybe I have done what they say. \q Maybe I have done something wrong.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, si j’ai fait cela, \q s’il y a de l’injustice dans mes paumes,
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, si j’ai fait ce qu’ils disent, \q si mes mains sont coupables d’injustice,
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} mon Dieu, j’ai peut-être fait ce qu’ils disent. \q J’ai peut-être fait quelque chose de mal.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, kama nimefanya hili, kama kuna uovu viganjani mwangu,
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, kama nimefanya wanayosema, kama mikono yangu ina hatia ya kosa,
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wangu, huenda nimefanya wanayosema. Huenda nimetenda jambo baya.

es.L: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, si he hecho esto, \q si hay injusticia en mis palmas,
es.B: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, si he hecho lo que dicen, \q si mis manos son culpables de algún mal,
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, Dios mío, tal vez he hecho lo que dicen. \q Tal vez he hecho algo malo.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, nếu tôi đã làm điều này, nếu có sự bất công trong lòng bàn tay tôi,
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, nếu tôi đã làm điều chúng nói, nếu tay tôi đã phạm điều sai trái,
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của tôi, có thể tôi đã làm điều chúng nói. Có thể tôi đã làm điều sai trái.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 제가 이 일을 했다면, 제 손바닥에 불의가 있다면,
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 그들의 말대로 제가 그런 일을 했다면, 제 손이 잘못을 저질렀다면,
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 저의 하나님, 어쩌면 제가 그들의 말대로 했을지도 모릅니다. 어쩌면 제가 무언가 잘못했을지도 모릅니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, se eu fiz isto, \q se há injustiça nas minhas palmas,
pt.B: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, se eu fiz o que dizem, \q se as minhas mãos são culpadas de algum mal,
pt.R: {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, meu Deus, talvez eu tenha feito o que eles dizem. \q Talvez eu tenha feito algo errado.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ ይህን አድርጌ ከሆነ፣ በእጆቼ መዳፍ ግፍ ቢገኝ፣
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ የሚሉትን አድርጌ ከሆነ፣ እጆቼ በበደል ተበክለው ከሆነ፣
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} አምላኬ ሆይ፣ የሚሉትን አድርጌ ይሆናል። ምናልባት ክፉ ነገር ሠርቼ ይሆናል።

hi.L: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर, यदि मैंने यह किया है, यदि मेरी हथेलियों में अन्याय है,
hi.B: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर, यदि मैंने वह किया है जो वे कहते हैं, यदि मेरे हाथ किसी बुराई के दोषी हैं,
hi.R: हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} मेरे परमेश्वर, हो सकता है कि मैंने वह किया हो जो वे कहते हैं। हो सकता है कि मैंने कुछ ग़लत किया हो।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, Боже мой, если я сделал это, если есть неправда в моих ладонях,
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, если я сделал то, о чём они говорят, если мои руки виновны в зле,
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, мой Бог, может быть, я сделал то, о чём они говорят. Может быть, я сделал что-то плохое.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの神よ、もしわたしがこのことをしたのなら、もしわたしの手のひらに不正があるなら、
ja.B: わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、もしわたしが、彼らの言うようなことをしたのなら、もしわたしの手が悪に汚れているなら、
ja.R: わたしの神、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、もしかしたら、わたしは彼らの言うようなことをしたのかもしれない。何か悪いことをしたのかもしれない。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, якщо я зробив це, якщо є неправда в моїх долонях,
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, якщо я зробив те, що вони кажуть, якщо мої руки винні в неправді,
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, мій Боже, можливо, я зробив те, що вони кажуть. Можливо, я вчинив щось погане.

decisions.choice: if I have done this: an oath of innocence
decisions.reason: Verses 4-6 are an oath: "if I have done this ..., then let the enemy ...". The psalmist calls a curse on himself if he is guilty, to declare that he is not (compare Job 31:5-40). "This" is the charge Cush has made.

decisions.choice: in my palms: on my hands, in what I have done
decisions.reason: The hands stand for what a person does; wrong "in the palms" is guilt for what they have done (Isaiah 59:6).

decisions.choice: what they say
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "this" refers to (m1).

decisions.choice: The oath of innocence (7:4-6) keeps one sentence over three verses at Literal and Balanced: もし…なら、 (7:4, 7:5) … するがよい (7:6)
decisions.reason: Each condition stays in its own verse and the curse follows in 7:6, the order of the Hebrew oath (m1); Readable splits it into short sentences as the English Readable does.

source.text: אִם־גָּ֭מַלְתִּי שֽׁוֹלְמִ֥י רָ֑ע וָאֲחַלְּצָ֖ה צוֹרְרִ֣י רֵיקָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: if I have repaid my friend [with] evil, or plundered my foe without cause,

en.L: if I have repaid the one at peace with me [with] evil, \q or have plundered my foe without cause,
en.B: if I have paid back a friend with harm, \q or robbed my enemy for no reason,
en.R: Maybe I have hurt a friend \q or robbed an enemy for no reason.

fr.L: si j’ai rendu le mal à celui qui était en paix avec moi, \q ou si j’ai dépouillé mon adversaire sans raison,
fr.B: si j’ai payé un ami de retour par du mal, \q ou si j’ai volé mon ennemi sans motif,
fr.R: J’ai peut-être fait du mal à un ami \q ou volé un ennemi sans raison.

sw.L: kama nimemlipa mabaya yule aliye na amani nami, au nimemnyang'anya mtesi wangu bila sababu,
sw.B: kama nimemlipa rafiki kwa madhara, au nimemnyang'anya adui yangu bila sababu,
sw.R: Huenda nimemwumiza rafiki au nimemnyang'anya adui bila sababu.

es.L: si he pagado con mal al que estaba en paz conmigo, \q o he despojado a mi adversario sin motivo,
es.B: si he devuelto daño a un amigo, \q o he robado a mi enemigo sin razón,
es.R: Tal vez le he hecho daño a un amigo \q o le he robado a un enemigo sin razón.

vi.L: nếu tôi đã lấy điều ác báo đáp người sống hòa thuận với tôi, hay đã cướp bóc kẻ thù tôi vô cớ,
vi.B: nếu tôi đã lấy điều hại báo trả một người bạn, hay đã cướp của kẻ thù tôi vô cớ,
vi.R: Có thể tôi đã làm hại một người bạn, hay cướp của một kẻ thù mà không có lý do.

ko.L: 저와 화평한 이에게 악으로 갚았다면, 까닭 없이 제 대적을 약탈했다면,
ko.B: 친구에게 해로 갚았다면, 까닭 없이 원수의 것을 빼앗았다면,
ko.R: 어쩌면 제가 친구를 해치거나 아무 이유 없이 원수의 것을 빼앗았을지도 모릅니다.

pt.L: se paguei com o mal a quem estava em paz comigo, \q ou se despojei o meu adversário sem motivo,
pt.B: se paguei um amigo com o mal, \q ou roubei o meu inimigo sem razão,
pt.R: Talvez eu tenha feito mal a um amigo \q ou roubado um inimigo sem motivo.

am.L: ከእኔ ጋር በሰላም ለነበረው ክፉን መልሼ ከሆነ፣ ወይም ባላጋራዬን ያለ ምክንያት ዘርፌ ከሆነ፣
am.B: ወዳጄን በክፉ መልሼ ከሆነ፣ ወይም ጠላቴን ያለ ምክንያት ዘርፌ ከሆነ፣
am.R: ምናልባት ወዳጄን ጎድቼ ወይም ጠላቴን ያለ ምክንያት ዘርፌ ይሆናል።

hi.L: यदि मैंने अपने साथ मेल रखनेवाले को बुराई से बदला दिया है, या अपने बैरी को अकारण लूटा है,
hi.B: यदि मैंने किसी मित्र को भलाई के बदले हानि पहुँचाई है, या बिना कारण अपने शत्रु को लूटा है,
hi.R: हो सकता है कि मैंने किसी मित्र को चोट पहुँचाई हो, या बिना कारण किसी दुश्मन को लूटा हो।

ru.L: если я отплатил злом тому, кто в мире со мной, или ограбил моего противника без причины,
ru.B: если я отплатил другу злом или без причины обобрал своего врага,
ru.R: Может быть, я обидел друга или без причины ограбил врага.

ja.L: もしわたしと平和にある者に悪をもって報い、あるいは、わたしの仇から理由もなく奪い取ったのなら、
ja.B: もし友に害をもって仕返しをし、あるいは、理由もなく敵から奪い取ったのなら、
ja.R: もしかしたら、友だちを傷つけたり、何の理由もなく敵から物を奪ったりしたのかもしれない。

uk.L: якщо я відплатив злом тому, хто жив зі мною в мирі, або пограбував свого супротивника без причини,
uk.B: якщо я відплатив другові кривдою або обібрав свого ворога без жодної причини,
uk.R: Можливо, я скривдив друга або без причини пограбував ворога.

decisions.choice: the one at peace with me: a friend, an ally
decisions.reason: The word (sholem) is someone who is at peace with him, a friend or ally (Psalm 41:10).

decisions.choice: plundered: stripped, robbed
decisions.reason: The verb (chalats) usually means to rescue, as in 6:5, but it can also mean to strip or plunder, which fits the list of wrongs here. Some read it in its usual sense, as a parenthesis: "I who rescued my enemy without cause", recalling how David spared Saul (1 Samuel 24; 26).

source.text: יִֽרַדֹּ֥ף אוֹיֵ֨ב׀נַפְשִׁ֡י וְיַשֵּׂ֗ג וְיִרְמֹ֣ס לָאָ֣רֶץ חַיָּ֑י וּכְבוֹדִ֓י׀לֶעָפָ֖ר יַשְׁכֵּ֣ן סֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: let an enemy pursue my soul and overtake [it], and trample to the earth my life, and my glory in the dust let him lay. Selah.

en.L: let an enemy pursue my soul and overtake [it]; \q let him trample my life to the ground \q and lay my glory in the dust. Selah
en.B: then let my enemy chase me down and catch me; \q let him trample my life into the ground \q and leave my honor lying in the dust. Selah
en.R: If I have, then let my enemy chase me and catch me. \q Let him crush me into the ground \q and bring me to shame. Selah

fr.L: que l’ennemi poursuive mon âme et [l’]atteigne ; \q qu’il piétine ma vie jusqu’à terre \q et couche ma gloire dans la poussière. Sélah
fr.B: alors que mon ennemi me pourchasse et me rattrape ; \q qu’il écrase ma vie contre le sol \q et laisse mon honneur traîner dans la poussière. Sélah
fr.R: Si c’est le cas, que mon ennemi me poursuive et m’attrape. \q Qu’il m’écrase contre le sol \q et me couvre de honte. Sélah

sw.L: basi adui na aifuatie nafsi yangu na kuipata; na ayakanyage maisha yangu chini ardhini, na autie utukufu wangu mavumbini. Sela
sw.B: basi adui yangu anifukuze na kunikamata; ayakanyage maisha yangu ardhini na kuiacha heshima yangu ikiwa mavumbini. Sela
sw.R: Kama nimefanya hivyo, basi adui yangu anifukuze na kunikamata. Aniponde chini na kuniaibisha. Sela

es.L: que persiga el enemigo mi alma y [la] alcance; \q que pisotee en tierra mi vida \q y ponga mi gloria en el polvo. Selah
es.B: entonces, que mi enemigo me persiga y me atrape; \q que aplaste mi vida contra el suelo \q y deje mi honra tirada en el polvo. Selah
es.R: Si es así, que mi enemigo me persiga y me atrape. \q Que me aplaste contra el suelo \q y me cubra de vergüenza. Selah

vi.L: thì nguyện kẻ thù đuổi theo linh hồn tôi và bắt kịp [nó]; nguyện nó giày đạp mạng sống tôi xuống đất và đặt vinh quang tôi trong bụi đất. Sê-la
vi.B: thì nguyện kẻ thù đuổi theo và bắt được tôi; nguyện nó giày đạp mạng sống tôi xuống đất, và để danh dự tôi nằm trong bụi đất. Sê-la
vi.R: Nếu tôi đã làm thế, thì nguyện kẻ thù đuổi theo và bắt được tôi. Nguyện nó đè bẹp tôi xuống đất và làm tôi bị nhục nhã. Sê-la

ko.L: 원수가 제 영혼을 뒤쫓아 따라잡게 하시고, 제 생명을 땅에 짓밟고 제 영광을 흙먼지 속에 눕히게 하십시오. 셀라
ko.B: 그렇다면 원수가 저를 쫓아와 붙잡고, 제 목숨을 땅에 짓밟으며, 제 명예를 흙먼지 속에 내버려 두게 하십시오. 셀라
ko.R: 만일 그랬다면, 제 원수가 저를 쫓아와 붙잡게 하십시오. 그가 저를 땅에 짓밟고 부끄럽게 만들게 하십시오. 셀라

pt.L: que o inimigo persiga a minha alma e [a] alcance; \q que pisoteie a minha vida no chão \q e deite a minha glória no pó. Selá
pt.B: então que o meu inimigo me persiga e me alcance; \q que pisoteie a minha vida no chão \q e deixe a minha honra caída no pó. Selá
pt.R: Se eu fiz isso, então que o meu inimigo me persiga e me pegue. \q Que ele me esmague no chão e me cubra de vergonha. Selá

am.L: ጠላት ነፍሴን ያሳድድ፤ ይያዛትም፤ ሕይወቴን በምድር ላይ ይርገጥ፤ ክብሬንም በትቢያ ውስጥ ያኑር። ሴላ
am.B: እንግዲያስ ጠላቴ ያሳድደኝ፤ ይያዘኝም፤ ሕይወቴን ወደ መሬት ይርገጣት፤ ክብሬንም በትቢያ ላይ ጥሎ ይተወው። ሴላ
am.R: ይህን አድርጌ ከሆነ ጠላቴ አሳድዶ ይያዘኝ። መሬት ላይ ይጨፍልቀኝ፤ ያዋርደኝም። ሴላ

hi.L: तो शत्रु मेरे प्राण का पीछा करे और [उसे] पकड़ ले; वह मेरे जीवन को भूमि पर रौंद डाले और मेरी महिमा को धूल में मिला दे। सेला
hi.B: तो मेरा शत्रु मेरा पीछा करके मुझे पकड़ ले; वह मेरे जीवन को ज़मीन में रौंद डाले और मेरे सम्मान को धूल में पड़ा छोड़ दे। सेला
hi.R: अगर मैंने ऐसा किया है, तो मेरा दुश्मन मेरा पीछा करे और मुझे पकड़ ले। वह मुझे ज़मीन पर कुचल दे और मेरा अपमान करे। सेला

ru.L: пусть гонится враг за моей душой и догонит [её], пусть растопчет до земли мою жизнь и уложит мою славу в пыль. Села
ru.B: тогда пусть мой враг гонится за мной и поймает меня; пусть вдавит мою жизнь в землю и оставит мою честь лежать в пыли. Села
ru.R: Если это так, пусть мой враг гонится за мной и поймает меня. Пусть он раздавит меня и опозорит меня. Села

ja.L: 敵がわたしの魂を追い、追いつくがよい。わたしの命を地に踏みにじり、わたしの栄光をちりの中に横たえさせるがよい。セラ
ja.B: そのときは、敵がわたしを追い詰めて捕らえ、わたしの命を地に踏みにじり、わたしの誉れをちりの中に打ち捨てるがよい。セラ
ja.R: もしそうなら、敵がわたしを追いかけて捕まえてもかまわない。わたしを地面に踏みつけて、恥をかかせてもかまわない。セラ

uk.L: нехай ворог переслідує мою душу й наздожене [її]; нехай втопче моє життя в землю і покладе мою славу в порох. Села
uk.B: то нехай мій ворог наздожене мене й схопить; нехай утопче моє життя в землю й залишить мою честь лежати в поросі. Села
uk.R: Якщо так, то нехай мій ворог жене мене й схопить. Нехай утопче мене в землю й укриє ганьбою. Села

decisions.choice: let an enemy pursue: the curse of the oath
decisions.reason: This is the "then" of the oath begun in verse 4: if he is guilty, let the enemy do to him what he has been praying to escape.

decisions.choice: my glory: my honor, or my very self
decisions.reason: Glory (kavod) is honor, as in 3:4 and 4:3; here, beside "soul" and "life", it may also stand for the self (compare Genesis 49:6).

decisions.choice: bring me to shame
alternatives: lay my glory in the dust
decisions.reason: Readable says what laying one's honor in the dust means (m2).

decisions.choice: Selah: a word whose meaning is no longer known
alternatives: lift up (the voice or the music)
decisions.reason: Selah stands at the end of a line 71 times in the Psalms and 3 times in Habakkuk 3. It is probably a direction for singing or music, perhaps a pause or an interlude; the ancient Greek translation renders it with a word meaning "interlude". It is not part of what is said, and here it marks a break after the line.

decisions.choice: Selah, kept as it is
decisions.reason: Its meaning is unknown (see the meaning decision on Selah), so every level keeps the word rather than guess, and keeps it apart from the sentence.

source.text: ק֘וּמָ֤ה יְהוָ֨ה׀בְּאַפֶּ֗ךָ הִ֭נָּשֵׂא בְּעַבְר֣וֹת צוֹרְרָ֑י וְע֥וּרָה אֵ֝לַ֗י מִשְׁפָּ֥ט צִוִּֽיתָ׃

records.literal_gloss: Arise, YHWH, in your anger; lift yourself up against the furies of my foes, and awake for me; judgment you have commanded.

en.L: Arise, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger; \q lift {{deity_pronoun:yourself|Yourself}} up against the fury of my foes, \q and awake for me; [the] judgment {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have commanded.
en.B: Rise up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} anger! \q Stand up against the rage of my enemies. \q Wake up and act for me; {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have ordered justice to be done.
en.R: Get up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}! Be angry and stand up against my furious enemies. \q Wake up and help me! \q You have said that what is right must be done.

fr.L: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ; \q dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre la fureur de mes adversaires, \q et éveille-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} pour moi ; [le] jugement, {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} l’as ordonné.
fr.B: Debout, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} colère ! \q Dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre la rage de mes ennemis. \q Réveille-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et agis pour moi ; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as ordonné que justice soit faite.
fr.R: Lève-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Mets-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} en colère et dresse-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} contre mes ennemis furieux. \q Réveille-{{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} et viens m’aider ! \q Tu as dit que ce qui est juste doit être fait.

sw.L: Inuka, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}; ujiinue dhidi ya ghadhabu ya watesi wangu, na uamke kwa ajili yangu; hukumu umeiamuru.
sw.B: Simama, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}! Jiinue dhidi ya ghadhabu ya adui zangu. Amka unitendee; umeamuru haki itendeke.
sw.R: Amka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Kasirika, usimame dhidi ya adui zangu wenye hasira kali. Usikae kimya tena; unisaidie! Umesema kwamba haki lazima itendeke.

es.L: Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira; \q álzate contra la furia de mis adversarios, \q y despierta por mí; [el] juicio {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has ordenado.
es.B: ¡Álzate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ira! \q Ponte en pie contra la rabia de mis enemigos. \q Despierta y actúa a mi favor; {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has ordenado que se haga justicia.
es.R: ¡Levántate, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}! Enójate y enfréntate a mis enemigos furiosos. \q ¡Despierta y ayúdame! \q Tú has dicho que debe hacerse lo que es justo.

vi.L: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin trỗi dậy trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; xin chỗi dậy chống lại cơn giận dữ của kẻ thù tôi, và xin thức dậy vì tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền lệnh [cho] sự phán xét.
vi.B: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin hãy đứng dậy trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Xin đứng lên chống lại cơn thịnh nộ của kẻ thù tôi. Xin thức dậy và hành động vì tôi; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền phải thi hành công lý.
vi.R: Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin hãy đứng lên! Xin nổi giận và đứng lên chống lại những kẻ thù hung tợn của tôi. Xin thức dậy và giúp tôi! Ngài đã phán rằng điều đúng phải được thực hiện.

ko.L: 일어나십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 주님의 진노 가운데! 제 대적들의 분노에 맞서 스스로 일어나시고, 저를 위해 깨어나십시오. 주님께서 심판을 명령하셨습니다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 진노하며 일어나십시오! 제 원수들의 격분에 맞서 일어서십시오. 깨어나셔서 저를 위해 일하여 주십시오. 주님께서 정의를 이루라고 명령하셨습니다.
ko.R: 일어나십시오, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여! 진노하셔서 분노에 찬 제 원수들에게 맞서 주십시오. 깨어나셔서 저를 도와주십시오! 주님께서는 옳은 일이 이루어져야 한다고 말씀하셨습니다.

pt.L: Levanta-te, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira; \q ergue-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} contra o furor dos meus adversários, \q e desperta por mim; [o] juízo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ordenaste.
pt.B: Levanta-te, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, na {{deity_pronoun:tua|Tua}} ira! \q Põe-{{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} de pé contra a fúria dos meus inimigos. \q Desperta e age em meu favor; {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} ordenaste que se faça justiça.
pt.R: Levanta-te, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}! Fica irado e enfrenta os meus inimigos furiosos. \q Acorda e me ajuda! \q Tu disseste que o que é certo tem de ser feito.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በቁጣህ ተነሥ፤ በባላጋራዎቼ ቁጣ ላይ ራስህን ከፍ አድርግ፤ ለእኔም ንቃ፤ ፍርድን አዝዘሃል።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ በቁጣህ ተነሥ! በጠላቶቼ ቁጣ ላይ ተነሣ። ንቃ፤ ለእኔም አድርግ፤ ፍትሕ እንዲደረግ አዝዘሃል።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ተነሥ! ተቆጣ፤ በተቆጡ ጠላቶቼም ላይ ተነሣ። ንቃ፤ እርዳኝም! ትክክል የሆነው መደረግ እንዳለበት ተናግረሃል።

hi.L: उठ, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने क्रोध में; मेरे बैरियों के रोष के विरुद्ध अपने आप को ऊँचा कर, और मेरे लिए जाग; तूने न्याय की आज्ञा दी है।
hi.B: उठ खड़ा हो, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, अपने क्रोध में! मेरे शत्रुओं के रोष के विरुद्ध खड़ा हो। जाग और मेरे लिए कुछ कर; तूने न्याय करने की आज्ञा दे दी है।
hi.R: उठ, हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}! क्रोधित हो और मेरे क्रोधी दुश्मनों के विरुद्ध खड़ा हो। जाग और मेरी मदद कर! तूने कहा है कि जो सही है वही होना चाहिए।

ru.L: Восстань, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} гневе; поднимись против ярости моих противников и пробудись для меня; суд {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} заповедал.
ru.B: Поднимись, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, в {{deity_pronoun:твоём|Твоём}} гневе! Выступи против ярости моих врагов. Проснись и вступись за меня; {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} повелел вершить правосудие.
ru.R: Встань, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}! Разгневайся и выступи против моих разъярённых врагов. Проснись и помоги мне! Ты сказал, что справедливость должна совершиться.

ja.L: 立ち上がってください、{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、あなたの怒りをもって。わたしの仇の激しい憤りに向かって、身を起こしてください。わたしのために目を覚ましてください。あなたは裁きを命じられた。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、怒りをもって立ち上がってください！わたしの敵の激しい憤りに立ち向かってください。目を覚まして、わたしのために動いてください。あなたは、正しい裁きを行うよう命じられたのだ。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、立ち上がってください！怒って、わたしのひどく怒っている敵に立ち向かってください。目を覚まして、わたしを助けてください！あなたは、正しいことが行われなければならないと言われた。

uk.L: Встань, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, у {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} гніві; піднімися проти люті моїх супротивників і пробудися для мене; суд {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} заповів.
uk.B: Повстань, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, у {{deity_pronoun:твоєму|Твоєму}} гніві! Стань проти шаленства моїх ворогів. Прокинься й дій заради мене; {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} звелів, щоб звершилося правосуддя.
uk.R: Встань, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}! Розгнівайся й виступи проти моїх лютих ворогів. Прокинься й допоможи мені! Ти сказав, що має бути зроблено те, що правильно.

decisions.choice: Arise, LORD: the battle cry of the ark
decisions.reason: As in 3:8, the words recall Numbers 10:35.

decisions.choice: awake: act at last
decisions.reason: God does not sleep (Psalm 121:4), but when he seems not to act, the psalmists call on him to wake up (Psalm 44:24).

decisions.choice: judgment you have commanded: you have already decreed justice
decisions.reason: The verb is in the past form: the LORD has already decreed that justice be done, and the psalmist asks him to carry it out. Some read it as a request.

decisions.choice: Rise up (B); Get up (R)
decisions.reason: As in 3:8.

decisions.choice: Восстань (L); Поднимись (B); Встань (R)
decisions.reason: As at 3:8: the battle cry of the ark (m1), in the words of Numbers 10:35 at Literal.

source.text: וַעֲדַ֣ת לְ֭אֻמִּים תְּסוֹבְבֶ֑ךָּ וְ֝עָלֶ֗יהָ לַמָּר֥וֹם שֽׁוּבָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And an assembly of peoples let surround you, and over it to the height return.

en.L: And let the assembly of peoples surround {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and over it return to the height.
en.B: Let the peoples gather around {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, \q and take {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} seat again above them on high.
en.R: Let the people of all nations gather around {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}. \q Then go back to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne in heaven above them and judge.

fr.L: Et que l’assemblée des peuples {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}entoure, \q et au-dessus d’elle retourne sur la hauteur.
fr.B: Que les peuples se rassemblent autour de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, \q et reprends {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} place au-dessus d’eux, là-haut.
fr.R: Que les gens de toutes les nations se rassemblent autour de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}. \q Puis retourne sur {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône dans le ciel, au-dessus d’eux, et juge.

sw.L: Na kusanyiko la watu likuzunguke, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} juu yake urudi mahali pa juu.
sw.B: Watu wa mataifa wakusanyike kukuzunguka, {{deity_pronoun:nawe|Nawe}} uketi tena kitini {{deity_pronoun:pako|Pako}} juu yao huko juu.
sw.R: Watu wa mataifa yote wakusanyike kukuzunguka. Kisha urudi kwenye kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi mbinguni juu yao, uhukumu.

es.L: Y que la asamblea de los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodee, \q y sobre ella vuelve a lo alto.
es.B: Que los pueblos se reúnan a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alrededor, \q y vuelve a ocupar {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} asiento por encima de ellos, en lo alto.
es.R: Que la gente de todas las naciones se reúna a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alrededor. \q Luego regresa a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono en el cielo, por encima de ellos, y juzga.

vi.L: Và nguyện hội chúng của các dân vây quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và [xin] trở về nơi cao trên nó.
vi.B: Nguyện các dân tụ họp quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, và xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở lại ngự trên ngai ở nơi cao, trên họ.
vi.R: Nguyện người của mọi dân tộc tụ họp quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Rồi xin {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trở về ngai {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} trên trời, ở trên họ, và phán xét.

ko.L: 백성들의 회중이 주님을 둘러싸게 하시고, 그 위 높은 곳으로 돌아가십시오.
ko.B: 백성들이 주님 주위에 모이게 하시고, 그들 위 높은 곳에 다시 자리 잡으십시오.
ko.R: 모든 민족의 사람들을 주님 주위에 모으십시오. 그런 다음 그들 위 하늘에 있는 주님의 보좌로 돌아가셔서 심판하십시오.

pt.L: E que a assembleia dos povos {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} rodeie, \q e sobre ela volta ao alto.
pt.B: Que os povos se reúnam ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} redor, \q e retoma o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} assento acima deles, nas alturas.
pt.R: Que as pessoas de todas as nações se reúnam ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} redor. \q Depois volta para o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} trono no céu, acima delas, e julga.

am.L: የሕዝቦችም ጉባኤ ይክበብህ፤ በላዩም ወደ ከፍታ ተመለስ።
am.B: ሕዝቦች በዙሪያህ ይሰብሰቡ፤ ከእነርሱም በላይ በከፍታ ላይ እንደ ገና ተቀመጥ።
am.R: የሁሉም ሕዝቦች ሰዎች በዙሪያህ ይሰብሰቡ። ከዚያም ከእነርሱ በላይ በሰማይ ወዳለው ዙፋንህ ተመልሰህ ፍረድ።

hi.L: और जातियों की सभा तुझे घेरे रहे, और उसके ऊपर ऊँचाई पर लौट जा।
hi.B: देश-देश के लोग तेरे चारों ओर इकट्ठे हों, और तू फिर से ऊँचे पर उनके ऊपर अपने आसन पर विराजमान हो।
hi.R: सब देशों के लोग तेरे चारों ओर इकट्ठे हों। फिर उनके ऊपर स्वर्ग में अपने सिंहासन पर लौट जा और न्याय कर।

ru.L: И пусть собрание племён окружит {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, и над ним вернись на высоту.
ru.B: Пусть племена соберутся вокруг {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}, и снова займи своё место над ними в вышине.
ru.R: Пусть люди всех народов соберутся вокруг {{deity_pronoun:тебя|Тебя}}. А потом вернись на свой престол на небе, над ними, и суди.

ja.L: 民らの集いが、あなたを囲むように。その上の高い所に、帰ってください。
ja.B: 民らがあなたの周りに集まるように。その上の高い所で、再び座に着いてください。
ja.R: すべての国の人々を、あなたの周りに集めてください。それから、彼らの上にある天の王座に戻って、裁いてください。

uk.L: І нехай громада племен оточить {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, а над нею повернися на висоту.
uk.B: Нехай народи зберуться довкола {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}, а {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знову сядь над ними на висоті.
uk.R: Нехай люди з усіх народів зберуться довкола {{deity_pronoun:тебе|Тебе}}. А тоді повернися на {{deity_pronoun:твій|Твій}} престол на небі над ними й суди.

decisions.choice: the assembly of peoples: a court gathered for judgment
decisions.reason: The peoples gather around God as in a law court, with God as judge (verse 9).

decisions.choice: return to the height: take your judgment seat
decisions.reason: "The height" is heaven, where God's throne is (Psalm 93:4). He is asked to take his seat again as judge. Some change one letter to read "sit" instead of "return"; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: and judge
decisions.reason: Readable says why God takes his seat, which verse 9 makes plain.

decisions.choice: "जातियों की सभा" (L); "देश-देश के लोग" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The peoples gathered as a court (meaning m1): Literal keeps "जातियों" as the poetry note gives for Literal, and Balanced and Readable say "the peoples of the nations" so that no word sounds like caste.

source.text: יְהוָה֮ יָדִ֪ין עַ֫מִּ֥ים שָׁפְטֵ֥נִי יְהוָ֑ה כְּצִדְקִ֖י וּכְתֻמִּ֣י עָלָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH judges peoples; judge me, YHWH, according to my righteousness and according to my integrity on me.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} judges peoples; \q judge me, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q according to my righteousness and according to my integrity [that is] in me.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} judges the peoples. \q Give me justice, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q because I am in the right and have done no wrong.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} judges all people. \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, judge me and show that I am right, \q because I have not done anything wrong.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} juge [les] peuples ; \q juge-moi, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q selon ma justice et selon mon intégrité [qui est] en moi.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} juge les peuples. \q Rends-moi justice, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q car je suis dans mon droit et je n’ai rien fait de mal.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} juge tous les peuples. \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, juge-moi et montre que j’ai raison, \q parce que je n’ai rien fait de mal.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawahukumu watu; unihukumu, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa kadiri ya haki yangu na kwa kadiri ya unyofu wangu [ulio] ndani yangu.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawahukumu watu wa mataifa. Unipe haki, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu niko sahihi na sijatenda kosa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anawahukumu watu wote. {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, unihukumu na uonyeshe kwamba niko sahihi, kwa sababu sijafanya jambo lolote baya.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzga a [los] pueblos; \q júzgame, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q conforme a mi justicia y conforme a mi integridad [que hay] en mí.
es.B: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzga a los pueblos. \q Hazme justicia, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q porque tengo la razón y no he hecho ningún mal.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} juzga a toda la gente. \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, júzgame y muestra que tengo la razón, \q porque no he hecho nada malo.

vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xét xử các dân; lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin xét xử tôi theo sự công chính của tôi và theo sự trọn vẹn [ở] trong tôi.
vi.B: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xét xử các dân. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin xét xử công minh cho tôi, vì tôi ngay thẳng và không làm điều gì sai trái.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} xét xử mọi người. Lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, xin xét xử tôi và cho thấy tôi đúng, vì tôi không làm điều gì sai.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 백성들을 심판하십니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저의 의를 따라, 제 안에 있는 저의 온전함을 따라 저를 판단하여 주십시오.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 백성들을 심판하십니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 공정하게 판결해 주십시오. 저는 옳으며 아무 잘못도 하지 않았습니다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모든 사람을 심판하십니다. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}여, 저를 판단하셔서 제가 옳다는 것을 보여 주십시오. 저는 아무 잘못도 하지 않았습니다.

pt.L: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} julga povos; \q faz-me justiça, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q conforme a minha justiça e conforme a integridade [que está] em mim.
pt.B: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} julga os povos. \q Faz-me justiça, {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, \q porque estou com a razão e não fiz nada de errado.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} julga todas as pessoas. \q {{divine_name:SENHOR|Javé}}, julga a minha causa e mostra que eu estou certo, \q porque eu não fiz nada de errado.

am.L: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቦች ይፈርዳል፤ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ እንደ ጽድቄና በእኔ እንዳለው ቅንነቴ ፍረድልኝ።
am.B: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሕዝቦች ላይ ይፈርዳል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ትክክል ስለ ሆንኩና ምንም በደል ስላልሠራሁ ፍትሕ ስጠኝ።
am.R: {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በሰዎች ሁሉ ላይ ይፈርዳል። {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} ሆይ፣ ምንም ክፉ ነገር ስላላደረግኩ ፍረድልኝ፤ ትክክል መሆኔንም አሳይ።

hi.L: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} जातियों का न्याय करते हैं; हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरी धार्मिकता के अनुसार और मुझमें [जो] खराई [है] उसके अनुसार मेरा न्याय कर।
hi.B: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} देशों का न्याय करते हैं। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मुझे न्याय दे, क्योंकि मैं सही हूँ और मैंने कोई बुराई नहीं की।
hi.R: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} सब लोगों का न्याय करते हैं। हे {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}}, मेरा न्याय कर और दिखा दे कि मैं सही हूँ, क्योंकि मैंने कुछ ग़लत नहीं किया।

ru.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} судит племена; рассуди меня, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, по праведности моей и по цельности моей, [что] во мне.
ru.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} судит племена. Защити моё право, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, потому что я прав и не сделал ничего дурного.
ru.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} судит всех людей. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Яхве}}, рассуди меня и покажи, что я прав, потому что я не сделал ничего плохого.

ja.L: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、もろもろの民を裁かれる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしの義に従い、わたしのうちにある無垢に従って、わたしを裁いてください。
ja.B: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、もろもろの民を裁かれる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしのために正しく裁いてください。わたしは正しく、何の悪も行っていないのだから。
ja.R: {{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}は、すべての人を裁かれる。{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}よ、わたしを裁いて、わたしが正しいことを示してください。わたしは、何も悪いことをしていないのだから。

uk.L: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} судить племена; суди мене, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, за моєю праведністю і за моєю непорочністю, [що] в мені.
uk.B: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} судить народи. Віддай мені по справедливості, {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, бо правда на моєму боці і я не вчинив зла.
uk.R: {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Ягве}} судить усіх людей. {{divine_name:ГОСПОДИ|Ягве}}, розсуди мене й покажи, що я правий, бо я не зробив нічого поганого.

decisions.choice: judge me: decide my case, vindicate me
decisions.reason: To judge (shafat) someone here is to give a ruling in his favor (Psalm 26:1).

decisions.choice: my righteousness, my integrity: innocent of the charge
decisions.reason: The psalmist does not claim to be sinless. He claims to be in the right in this matter, innocent of what he is accused of (verses 4-5).

decisions.choice: because I am in the right and have done no wrong (B)
alternatives: according to my righteousness and my integrity
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what righteousness and integrity mean here (m2).

decisions.choice: honorific "न्याय करते हैं", then "तू" ("न्याय कर")
decisions.reason: The verse speaks about the LORD and then to him; the Hindi turns from the honorific third person to "तू" with it, as in 5:7.

decisions.choice: tsidqi "わたしの義" (L), Balanced and Readable as clauses; tummi "無垢" (L), as Job
decisions.reason: The psalmist's own tsedeq means being in the right on this charge (m2); Literal keeps the key term, and Balanced and Readable say it as the English does.

source.text: יִגְמָר־נָ֬א רַ֨ע׀רְשָׁעִים֮ וּתְכוֹנֵ֪ן צַ֫דִּ֥יק וּבֹחֵ֣ן לִ֭בּ֗וֹת וּכְלָי֗וֹת אֱלֹהִ֥ים צַדִּֽיק׃

records.literal_gloss: Let come to an end, please, [the] evil of wicked [people], and establish [the] righteous, and testing hearts and kidneys [is] righteous God.

en.L: Please let the evil of the wicked come to an end, and establish the righteous, \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} who test hearts and kidneys, righteous God.
en.B: Bring the evil of the wicked to an end, and make the righteous secure, \q for {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} are the righteous God who tests minds and hearts.
en.R: Put an end to the evil that wicked people do. Keep good people safe. \q You are a God who does what is right, and {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} know what people think and want.

fr.L: Que prenne fin, je {{deity_pronoun:t’|T’}}en prie, le mal des méchants, et affermis le juste, \q {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} qui sondes les cœurs et les reins, Dieu juste.
fr.B: Mets fin au mal que font les méchants, et donne au juste un appui solide, \q car {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} es le Dieu juste qui sonde les pensées et les cœurs.
fr.R: Arrête le mal que font les méchants. Garde en sécurité ceux qui font le bien. \q Tu es un Dieu qui fait ce qui est juste, et {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sais ce que les gens pensent et désirent.

sw.L: Tafadhali uovu wa waovu ukome, na umthibitishe mwenye haki, {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unayepima mioyo na figo, Ee Mungu mwenye haki.
sw.B: Ukomeshe uovu wa waovu, na uwaimarishe wenye haki, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} ndiwe Mungu mwenye haki unayepima mawazo na mioyo.
sw.R: Ukomeshe maovu wanayoyatenda watu waovu. Uwalinde watu wema. Wewe ni Mungu anayetenda haki, na {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} unajua watu wanachofikiri na wanachotaka.

es.L: Que se acabe, por favor, la maldad de los malvados, y afirma [al] justo, \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} que pruebas corazones y riñones, Dios justo.
es.B: Pon fin a la maldad de los malvados y da seguridad a los justos, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} eres el Dios justo que examina mentes y corazones.
es.R: Acaba con el mal que hacen los malvados. Protege a las personas buenas. \q Tú eres un Dios que hace lo que es justo, y {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} sabes lo que la gente piensa y desea.

vi.L: Xin chấm dứt điều ác của kẻ ác, và xin làm cho người công chính được vững lập, hỡi Đấng dò xét lòng và thận, Đức Chúa Trời công chính.
vi.B: Xin chấm dứt điều ác của kẻ ác, và cho người công chính được vững vàng, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời công chính, Đấng dò xét tâm trí và lòng người.
vi.R: Xin chấm dứt những điều ác mà kẻ ác làm. Xin giữ cho người tốt được an toàn. Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời làm điều đúng, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biết điều người ta nghĩ và điều họ muốn.

ko.L: 부디 악인들의 악이 끝나게 하시고, 의인을 굳게 세워 주십시오. 마음과 콩팥을 시험하시는 분, 의로우신 하나님이시여.
ko.B: 악인들의 악을 끝내시고, 의인을 든든히 세워 주십시오. 주님은 사람의 생각과 마음을 시험하시는 의로우신 하나님이십니다.
ko.R: 악한 사람들이 하는 악한 일을 끝내 주십시오. 바르게 사는 사람들을 안전하게 지켜 주십시오. 주님은 옳은 일을 하시는 하나님이시며, 사람들이 무엇을 생각하고 바라는지 아십니다.

pt.L: Que acabe, por favor, o mal dos ímpios, e firma o justo, \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} que provas corações e rins, ó Deus justo.
pt.B: Põe fim à maldade dos ímpios e dá segurança aos justos, \q pois {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} és o Deus justo, que examina mentes e corações.
pt.R: Acaba com o mal que as pessoas más fazem. Guarda em segurança as pessoas boas. \q Tu és um Deus que faz o que é certo, e {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} sabes o que as pessoas pensam e desejam.

am.L: እባክህ የክፉዎች ክፋት ይብቃ፤ ጻድቁንም አጽና፤ ልብንና ኩላሊትን የምትመረምር፣ ጻድቅ አምላክ ሆይ።
am.B: የክፉዎችን ክፋት አስወግድ፤ ጻድቃንንም አጽና፤ አንተ ሐሳብንና ልብን የምትመረምር ጻድቅ አምላክ ነህና።
am.R: ክፉ ሰዎች የሚያደርጉትን ክፋት አስቁም። መልካም ሰዎችን በደኅንነት ጠብቅ። አንተ ትክክል የሆነውን የምታደርግ አምላክ ነህ፤ ሰዎች የሚያስቡትንና የሚፈልጉትንም ታውቃለህ።

hi.L: कृपया दुष्टों की बुराई का अंत हो, और धर्मी को स्थिर कर, हे मनों और गुर्दों को जाँचनेवाले, धर्मी परमेश्वर।
hi.B: दुष्टों की बुराई का अंत कर दे, और धर्मी को सुरक्षित रख, क्योंकि तू धर्मी परमेश्वर है, जो मन और हृदय को जाँचता है।
hi.R: दुष्ट लोग जो बुराई करते हैं, उसका अंत कर दे। अच्छे लोगों को सुरक्षित रख। तू ऐसा परमेश्वर है जो सही करता है, और तू जानता है कि लोग क्या सोचते और क्या चाहते हैं।

ru.L: Пусть же прекратится зло нечестивых, и утверди праведного, {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}}, испытывающий сердца и почки, Боже праведный.
ru.B: Положи конец злу нечестивых и дай праведным твёрдо стоять, ведь {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} — праведный Бог, испытывающий умы и сердца.
ru.R: Положи конец злу, которое творят злые люди. Сохрани хороших людей. Ты Бог, который поступает правильно, и {{deity_pronoun:ты|Ты}} знаешь, что люди думают и чего хотят.

ja.L: どうか、悪しき者たちの悪が絶えるように。正しい者を堅く立ててください、心と腎臓とを試される方、正しい神よ。
ja.B: 悪しき者たちの悪を終わらせ、正しい人を揺るがないようにしてください。あなたは、人の思いと心を試される、正しい神なのだから。
ja.R: 悪い人たちのする悪を、終わらせてください。正しい人たちを守ってください。あなたは、いつも正しいことをなさる神だ。人の考えていることも、望んでいることも、知っておられる。

uk.L: Нехай же покінчиться зло нечестивих, і утверди праведного, {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}}, що випробовуєш серця й нирки, праведний Боже.
uk.B: Поклади край злу нечестивих і дай праведним стояти певно, бо {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} — праведний Бог, що випробовує думки й серця.
uk.R: Поклади край злу, яке чинять злі люди. Бережи добрих людей. Ти — Бог, який чинить правильно, і {{deity_pronoun:ти|Ти}} знаєш, що люди думають і чого хочуть.

decisions.choice: hearts and kidneys: thoughts and feelings
decisions.reason: In Hebrew thought the heart is the seat of thought and will, and the kidneys of the deepest feelings (Jeremiah 11:20; 17:10). God examines the whole inner person.

decisions.choice: testing ... righteous God: said to God
decisions.reason: The words are addressed to God and describe him, giving the reason he can be trusted to judge.

decisions.choice: minds and hearts (B); what people think and want (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the parts that mean these things in English (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture.

decisions.choice: las personas buenas
decisions.reason: As in Proverbs, where the English Readable says "good people" for the righteous, Readable Spanish says "las personas buenas"; Literal and Balanced keep "el justo, los justos".

decisions.choice: "lòng và thận" (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the body words, as in Psalm 139:13, so the reader sees the Hebrew picture of the inner self; Balanced and Readable say what is meant, the mind and the heart.

decisions.choice: hearts and kidneys as "ሐሳብንና ልብን" (B), "የሚያስቡትንና የሚፈልጉትን" (R); Literal keeps "ልብንና ኩላሊትን"
decisions.reason: In Hebrew the kidneys are the seat of feeling (meaning decision m1); in Amharic they are only an organ, so Balanced and Readable give the sense.

decisions.choice: "मनों और गुर्दों" (L); "मन और हृदय" (B)
decisions.reason: The heart and kidneys stand for thoughts and feelings (meaning m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced says "मन और हृदय", the pair Hindi uses for the inner self, as Revelation 2:23 in this translation does; Readable says what is meant.

decisions.choice: сердца и почки (L); умы и сердца (B); что люди думают и чего хотят (R)
decisions.reason: The hearts and kidneys stand for thoughts and feelings (m1). Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced uses the words that mean these things in Russian, and Readable says it plainly, as the English does.

decisions.choice: livvot ukhlayot "心と腎臓" (L), "思いと心" (B), Readable as a clause
decisions.reason: The Hebrew pairs heart and kidneys for thoughts and feelings (m1); Literal keeps the picture, the other levels say what it means.

records.literal_gloss: My shield [is] on God, saving [the] upright of heart.

en.L: My shield [is] upon God, \q who saves the upright of heart.
en.B: My shield is God, \q who rescues those whose hearts are right.
en.R: God protects me like a shield. \q He saves people who are honest and good.

fr.L: Mon bouclier [est] sur Dieu, \q qui sauve les cœurs droits.
fr.B: Mon bouclier, c’est Dieu, \q qui délivre ceux qui ont le cœur droit.
fr.R: Dieu me protège comme un bouclier. \q Il sauve les gens honnêtes et bons.

sw.L: Ngao yangu [iko] juu ya Mungu, aokoaye wanyofu wa moyo.
sw.B: Ngao yangu ni Mungu, anayewaokoa wale wenye mioyo minyofu.
sw.R: Mungu ananilinda kama ngao. Yeye huwaokoa watu walio waaminifu na wema.

es.L: Mi escudo [está] sobre Dios, \q que salva a los rectos de corazón.
es.B: Mi escudo es Dios, \q que rescata a los de corazón recto.
es.R: Dios me protege como un escudo. \q Él salva a la gente honrada y buena.

vi.L: Cái khiên của tôi [ở] nơi Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng cứu những người có lòng ngay thẳng.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời là cái khiên của tôi, Đấng giải cứu những người có lòng ngay thẳng.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời bảo vệ tôi như một cái khiên. Ngài cứu những người thật thà và tốt lành.

ko.L: 내 방패는 하나님께 있으니, 그분은 마음이 정직한 사람을 구원하신다.
ko.B: 내 방패는 하나님이시니, 그분께서 마음이 바른 사람들을 건지신다.
ko.R: 하나님께서 방패처럼 나를 지켜 주신다. 그분은 정직하고 착한 사람들을 구원하신다.

pt.L: O meu escudo [está] sobre Deus, \q que salva os retos de coração.
pt.B: O meu escudo é Deus, \q que livra aqueles cujo coração é reto.
pt.R: Deus me protege como um escudo. \q Ele salva as pessoas honestas e boas.

am.L: ጋሻዬ በእግዚአብሔር ላይ [ነው]፤ እርሱ ልበ ቅኖችን ያድናል።
am.B: ጋሻዬ እግዚአብሔር ነው፤ ልባቸው ቅን የሆነውን ያድናል።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር እንደ ጋሻ ይጠብቀኛል። ሐቀኞችንና መልካም ሰዎችን ያድናል።

hi.L: मेरी ढाल परमेश्वर पर [है], जो सीधे मनवालों को बचाते हैं।
hi.B: मेरी ढाल परमेश्वर हैं, जो सीधे मनवालों को छुड़ाते हैं।
hi.R: परमेश्वर ढाल की तरह मेरी रक्षा करते हैं। वे उन लोगों को बचाते हैं जो ईमानदार और भले हैं।

ru.L: Мой щит — на Боге, спасающем тех, чьё сердце прямо.
ru.B: Мой щит — Бог, который спасает тех, чьё сердце честно.
ru.R: Бог защищает меня, как щит. Он спасает людей честных и добрых.

ja.L: わたしの盾は、神にかかっている、心のまっすぐな者たちを救われる方に。
ja.B: わたしの盾は神。心の正しい人たちを救い出される方だ。
ja.R: 神は、盾のようにわたしを守ってくださる。正直で良い人たちを、救ってくださる。

uk.L: Мій щит — на Бозі, що спасає праведних серцем.
uk.B: Мій щит — Бог, який рятує тих, у кого серце праве.
uk.R: Бог захищає мене, як щит. Він спасає людей чесних і добрих.

decisions.choice: my shield is upon God: God holds my shield
decisions.reason: The phrase says that his protection rests on God, as a shield is held by its bearer. Compare 3:4, "you are a shield around me".

decisions.choice: upright of heart: people whose hearts are straight
decisions.reason: The upright (yashar) are straight, not crooked; "of heart" means inwardly so, not only in appearance.

decisions.choice: Verses 11-18 speak about God in the plain written style with the honorific, and the psalmist is "나"
alternatives: 합쇼체 and 저 as in verses 2-10
decisions.reason: From here the psalm speaks of God in the third person ("God", "he"); Korean marks the change as in Psalms 3 and 23. "정직한 사람" is the terms note's word for the upright.

decisions.choice: "सीधे मनवाले"
decisions.reason: The upright are "सीधे लोग" in the poetry note; with "of heart" (meaning m2) Hindi says "सीधे मनवाले". Readable says it in everyday words.

decisions.choice: yishrei-lev "心のまっすぐな者たち" (L), "心の正しい人たち" (B), Readable as the English; yashar alone まっすぐな者 (L), 心のまっすぐな人 (B), 正しく生きる人 (R)
decisions.reason: Proverbs' forms for the upright; the heart is named where the Hebrew names it.

decisions.choice: "праведні серцем" (L), "ті, у кого серце праве" (B) for the upright of heart, through the book
decisions.reason: The phrase is about a heart set straight towards God; "щирий" now means sincere, which says less.

source.text: אֱ֭לֹהִים שׁוֹפֵ֣ט צַדִּ֑יק וְ֝אֵ֗ל זֹעֵ֥ם בְּכָל־יֽוֹם׃

records.literal_gloss: God [is] a righteous judge, and God [is] indignant every day.

en.L: God [is] a righteous judge, \q and a God who is indignant every day.
en.B: God is a righteous judge, \q a God who is angry at evil every day.
en.R: God is a fair judge. \q Every day {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is angry at the evil people do.

fr.L: Dieu [est] un juge juste, \q et un Dieu qui s’indigne chaque jour.
fr.B: Dieu est un juge juste, \q un Dieu qui s’indigne contre le mal chaque jour.
fr.R: Dieu est un juge honnête. \q Chaque jour, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en colère contre le mal que font les gens.

sw.L: Mungu [ni] mwamuzi mwenye haki, na Mungu mwenye ghadhabu kila siku.
sw.B: Mungu ni mwamuzi mwenye haki, Mungu anayekasirikia uovu kila siku.
sw.R: Mungu ni mwamuzi wa haki. Kila siku anakasirikia maovu wanayotenda watu.

es.L: Dios [es] juez justo, \q y un Dios que se indigna cada día.
es.B: Dios es un juez justo, \q un Dios que se enoja contra el mal cada día.
es.R: Dios es un juez imparcial. \q Cada día {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} se enoja por el mal que hace la gente.

vi.L: Đức Chúa Trời [là] thẩm phán công chính, và [là] Đức Chúa Trời phẫn nộ mỗi ngày.
vi.B: Đức Chúa Trời là thẩm phán công chính, là Đức Chúa Trời mỗi ngày đều nổi giận vì điều ác.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời là thẩm phán công bằng. Mỗi ngày {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đều giận những điều ác người ta làm.

ko.L: 하나님은 의로운 재판관이시며, 날마다 진노하시는 하나님이시다.
ko.B: 하나님은 의로운 재판관이시며, 날마다 악에 대해 노하시는 하나님이시다.
ko.R: 하나님은 공정한 재판관이시다. 그분은 날마다 사람들이 저지르는 악에 대해 노하신다.

pt.L: Deus [é] juiz justo, \q e Deus [está] indignado a cada dia.
pt.B: Deus é um juiz justo, \q um Deus que se ira contra o mal todos os dias.
pt.R: Deus é um juiz que julga com justiça. \q Todos os dias {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fica irado com o mal que as pessoas fazem.

am.L: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ፈራጅ [ነው]፤ በየቀኑም የሚቆጣ አምላክ [ነው]።
am.B: እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ፈራጅ ነው፤ በየቀኑ በክፋት ላይ የሚቆጣ አምላክ ነው።
am.R: እግዚአብሔር ትክክለኛ ፈራጅ ነው። ሰዎች በሚያደርጉት ክፋት በየቀኑ ይቆጣል።

hi.L: परमेश्वर धर्मी न्यायी [हैं], और ऐसे परमेश्वर जो हर दिन क्रोधित होते हैं।
hi.B: परमेश्वर धर्मी न्यायी हैं, ऐसे परमेश्वर जो हर दिन बुराई पर क्रोधित होते हैं।
hi.R: परमेश्वर खरे न्यायी हैं। वे हर दिन लोगों के बुरे कामों पर क्रोधित होते हैं।

ru.L: Бог — праведный судья, и Бог, гневающийся каждый день.
ru.B: Бог — праведный судья, Бог, который каждый день гневается на зло.
ru.R: Бог — справедливый судья. Каждый день {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} гневается на зло, которое делают люди.

ja.L: 神は正しい裁き手、日ごとに憤られる神。
ja.B: 神は正しい裁き手。毎日、悪に対して怒られる神だ。
ja.R: 神は、公平な裁判官だ。毎日、人々のする悪に怒っておられる。

uk.L: Бог — праведний суддя, і Бог, що гнівається щодня.
uk.B: Бог — праведний суддя, Бог, що щодня гнівається на зло.
uk.R: Бог — справедливий суддя. Щодня {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} гнівається на зло, яке чинять люди.

decisions.choice: indignant: angry at wrong
decisions.reason: The verb (za'am) is to be indignant. The text does not say with whom; the context shows it is with the wicked who do not turn (verse 13).

decisions.choice: at evil (B); at the evil people do (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what God is angry at (m1).

source.text: אִם־לֹ֣א יָ֭שׁוּב חַרְבּ֣וֹ יִלְט֑וֹשׁ קַשְׁתּ֥וֹ דָ֝רַ֗ךְ וַֽיְכוֹנְנֶֽהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: If he does not turn, his sword he will sharpen; his bow he has bent and made it ready.

en.L: If [one] does not turn back, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will sharpen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has bent {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow and made it ready.
en.B: If anyone will not turn back, God will sharpen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has strung {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow and taken aim.
en.R: If people do not turn from evil, God will sharpen {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} sword. \q He has {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} bow ready to shoot.

fr.L: Si [l’on] ne revient pas, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aiguisera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a tendu {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc et l’a tenu prêt.
fr.B: Si quelqu’un refuse de revenir, Dieu aiguisera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a bandé {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} arc et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vise.
fr.R: Si les gens ne se détournent pas du mal, Dieu aiguisera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} épée. \q Son arc est prêt à tirer.

sw.L: Mtu asipogeuka, atanoa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; ameupinda upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuuweka tayari.
sw.B: Mtu yeyote asipogeuka, Mungu atanoa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}; amefunga uzi wa upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kulenga.
sw.R: Watu wasipoacha maovu, Mungu atanoa upanga {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Upinde {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} uko tayari kupiga.

es.L: Si [uno] no se vuelve, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} afilará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco ha tensado y [lo] ha preparado.
es.B: Si alguien no se vuelve atrás, Dios afilará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada; \q ha tensado {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco y apunta.
es.R: Si la gente no se aparta del mal, Dios afilará {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} espada. \q Tiene {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} arco listo para disparar.

vi.L: Nếu [người ta] không quay trở lại, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ mài gươm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã giương cung của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và sửa soạn sẵn.
vi.B: Nếu ai không chịu quay lại, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ mài gươm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã lên dây cung và nhắm sẵn.
vi.R: Nếu người ta không từ bỏ điều ác, Đức Chúa Trời sẽ mài gươm của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. Ngài đã có cung của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẵn sàng để bắn.

ko.L: [사람이] 돌이키지 않으면, 그분께서 그분의 칼을 가실 것이다. 그분께서 그분의 활을 당겨 준비하셨다.
ko.B: 누구든지 돌이키지 않으면 하나님께서 칼을 가실 것이다. 그분께서 활시위를 매고 겨누셨다.
ko.R: 사람들이 악에서 돌아서지 않으면 하나님께서 칼을 가실 것이다. 그분께서는 활을 쏠 준비를 마치셨다.

pt.L: Se [alguém] não voltar atrás, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} afiará a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} espada; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} armou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} arco e o preparou.
pt.B: Se alguém não voltar atrás, Deus vai afiar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} espada; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} já armou o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} arco e fez pontaria.
pt.R: Se as pessoas não deixarem o mal, Deus vai afiar a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} espada. \q Ele está com o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} arco pronto para atirar.

am.L: [ሰው] ባይመለስ ሰይፉን ይስላል፤ ቀስቱን ገትሯል፤ አዘጋጅቶታልም።
am.B: ማንም ባይመለስ እግዚአብሔር ሰይፉን ይስላል፤ ቀስቱን ወጥሮ አነጣጥሯል።
am.R: ሰዎች ከክፋታቸው ባይመለሱ እግዚአብሔር ሰይፉን ይስላል። ቀስቱን ለመወርወር አዘጋጅቷል።

hi.L: यदि [कोई] न लौटे, तो वे अपनी तलवार पर धार चढ़ाएँगे; उन्होंने अपना धनुष चढ़ाकर तैयार कर रखा है।
hi.B: यदि कोई न लौटे, तो परमेश्वर अपनी तलवार पैनी करेंगे; उन्होंने अपना धनुष चढ़ा लिया है और निशाना साध लिया है।
hi.R: अगर लोग बुराई से नहीं मुड़ते, तो परमेश्वर अपनी तलवार पैनी करेंगे। उनका धनुष चलाने के लिए तैयार है।

ru.L: Если [кто] не обратится, {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} наточит свой меч; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} натянул свой лук и приготовил его.
ru.B: Если кто-то не повернёт назад, Бог наточит свой меч; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} натянул тетиву своего лука и прицелился.
ru.R: Если люди не отвернутся от зла, Бог наточит свой меч. Его лук готов к выстрелу.

ja.L: [人が]立ち返らないなら、その方は剣を研がれる。弓を引き絞って、それを構えられた。
ja.B: 人が立ち返らないなら、神は剣を研がれる。弓を張り、ねらいを定めておられる。
ja.R: 人々が悪から離れないなら、神は剣を研がれる。弓を構えて、今にも射ようとしておられる。

uk.L: Якщо [хтось] не навернеться, {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} нагострить свій меч; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} натягнув свій лук і приготував його.
uk.B: Якщо хтось не навернеться, Бог нагострить свій меч; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} натягнув тятиву свого лука й прицілився.
uk.R: Якщо люди не відвернуться від зла, Бог нагострить свій меч. Його лук уже готовий до пострілу.

decisions.choice: If he does not turn, he will sharpen: God readies his weapons against the unrepentant
alternatives: if he (the wicked) does not turn, he sharpens his sword (against the righteous)
decisions.reason: The subject changes without notice. Most likely: if the wicked man does not turn back, God will sharpen his sword. Some read the wicked man as the subject throughout, arming himself, and his weapons turning against him (verses 15-17).

decisions.choice: turn: turn back from evil, repent
decisions.reason: To turn (shuv) is to change direction, here from wrongdoing (Ezekiel 18:30).

decisions.choice: bent his bow: strung it, ready to shoot
decisions.reason: A bow was bent by stepping on it to string it (literally "trodden").

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name God as the one who sharpens the sword (m1).

decisions.choice: God as the subject of the weapons (その方 L, 神 B, R), with respect forms; shuv "立ち返る" (L, B), "悪から離れる" (R)
alternatives: 彼は剣を研ぐ (the unrepentant man as subject)
decisions.reason: m1 reads God readying his weapons against the one who will not repent (uncertain); the respect forms make the subject God in Japanese, where the Hebrew has only "he".

source.text: וְ֭לוֹ הֵכִ֣ין כְּלֵי־מָ֑וֶת חִ֝צָּ֗יו לְֽדֹלְקִ֥ים יִפְעָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And for him he has prepared weapons of death; his arrows he makes into burning [ones].

en.L: And for him {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has prepared weapons of death; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows flaming.
en.B: He has made ready deadly weapons for that person, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} turns {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} arrows into fire.
en.R: He has deadly weapons ready for that person. \q His arrows are on fire.

fr.L: Et pour lui {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a préparé des armes de mort ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} rend {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches brûlantes.
fr.B: Il a préparé des armes mortelles pour cet homme-là, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} change {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} flèches en feu.
fr.R: Il a des armes mortelles toutes prêtes pour lui. \q Ses flèches sont en feu.

sw.L: Na kwa ajili yake ameandaa silaha za mauti; mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} anaifanya ya moto.
sw.B: Ameandaa silaha za kuua kwa ajili ya mtu huyo, na anaigeuza mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kuwa moto.
sw.R: Ana silaha za kuua tayari kwa ajili ya mtu huyo. Mishale {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} inawaka moto.

es.L: Y ha preparado para él armas de muerte; \q hace llameantes {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas.
es.B: Ha preparado armas mortales para esa persona, \q y convierte {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} flechas en fuego.
es.R: Tiene armas mortales listas para esa persona. \q Sus flechas están encendidas.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã sửa soạn cho nó các khí giới chết người; {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho các mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bốc lửa.
vi.B: Ngài đã chuẩn bị khí giới chết người cho kẻ ấy, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} biến các mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thành lửa.
vi.R: Ngài có sẵn khí giới chết người cho kẻ ấy. Các mũi tên của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang cháy rực.

ko.L: 그를 위해 그분께서 죽음의 무기를 준비하셨고, 그분의 화살을 불화살로 만드신다.
ko.B: 그분께서 그 사람을 위해 죽음의 무기를 마련하시고, 화살을 불화살로 만드신다.
ko.R: 그분께서 그 사람을 칠 무서운 무기를 준비해 두셨다. 그분의 화살에는 불이 붙어 있다.

pt.L: E para ele {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} preparou armas de morte; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} faz as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} flechas flamejantes.
pt.B: Ele preparou armas mortais para essa pessoa \q e transforma as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} flechas em fogo.
pt.R: Ele tem armas mortais prontas para essa pessoa. \q As flechas {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}} estão em chamas.

am.L: ለእርሱም የሞት መሣሪያዎችን አዘጋጅቷል፤ ፍላጻዎቹንም የሚነድዱ ያደርጋቸዋል።
am.B: ለዚያ ሰው ገዳይ መሣሪያዎችን አዘጋጅቷል፤ ፍላጻዎቹንም እሳት ያደርጋቸዋል።
am.R: ለዚያ ሰው ገዳይ መሣሪያዎችን አዘጋጅቷል። ፍላጻዎቹ በእሳት ይነድዳሉ።

hi.L: और उसके लिए उन्होंने मृत्यु के हथियार तैयार किए हैं; वे अपने तीरों को जलते हुए बनाते हैं।
hi.B: उन्होंने उस व्यक्ति के लिए घातक हथियार तैयार कर रखे हैं, और वे अपने तीरों को आग बना देते हैं।
hi.R: उनके पास उस व्यक्ति के लिए घातक हथियार तैयार हैं। उनके तीरों में आग लगी है।

ru.L: И для него {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} приготовил орудия смерти; {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} делает свои стрелы пылающими.
ru.B: Он приготовил для такого человека смертоносное оружие, и {{deity_pronoun:он|Он}} превращает свои стрелы в огонь.
ru.R: У {{deity_pronoun:него|Него}} готово смертоносное оружие для такого человека. Его стрелы горят.

ja.L: そして、その者のために死の武器を備え、その矢を燃える矢とされる。
ja.B: その方は、その者のために死をもたらす武器を備え、その矢を火の矢とされる。
ja.R: その人のために、命を奪う武器を用意しておられる。その方の矢は、燃えている。

uk.L: І для нього {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} приготував знаряддя смерті; {{deity_pronoun:він|Він}} робить свої стріли палаючими.
uk.B: Він приготував для такої людини смертельну зброю і робить свої стріли вогняними.
uk.R: У нього напоготові смертельна зброя для такої людини. Його стріли палають.

decisions.choice: for him: for the one who will not turn
decisions.reason: "Him" is the person of verse 13 who will not turn back.

decisions.choice: burning arrows: fire-arrows
decisions.reason: Arrows wrapped with burning material were shot in sieges. God's judgment is pictured as a warrior's attack (Deuteronomy 32:23, 42).

source.text: הִנֵּ֥ה יְחַבֶּל־אָ֑וֶן וְהָרָ֥ה עָ֝מָ֗ל וְיָ֣לַד שָֽׁקֶר׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, he travails [with] iniquity, and he conceives trouble and gives birth to falsehood.

en.L: Look, he is in labor with iniquity; \q he has conceived trouble and given birth to falsehood.
en.B: See how the wicked person is pregnant with evil: \q having conceived trouble, he gives birth to lies.
en.R: Look at the wicked person. He plans evil the way a woman carries a baby. \q He plans trouble, and what comes out is lies.

fr.L: Voici, il est en travail d’iniquité ; \q il a conçu la peine et enfanté le mensonge.
fr.B: Voyez le méchant : il est gros de malfaisance ; \q il a conçu le malheur et il enfante le mensonge.
fr.R: Regardez le méchant. Il prépare le mal comme une femme porte un bébé. \q Il prépare des ennuis, et ce qui en sort, ce sont des mensonges.

sw.L: Tazama, ana utungu wa uovu; amechukua mimba ya taabu na kuzaa uongo.
sw.B: Tazama jinsi mtu mwovu alivyo na mimba ya uovu: akiisha kuchukua mimba ya taabu, anazaa uongo.
sw.R: Mwangalie mtu mwovu. Anapanga maovu kama mwanamke anavyobeba mimba. Anapanga taabu, na kinachozaliwa ni uongo.

es.L: Mira, está con dolores de parto de iniquidad; \q ha concebido malicia y ha dado a luz mentira.
es.B: Así es el malvado: está preñado de maldad; \q concibió malicia, y da a luz mentiras.
es.R: Así es la persona malvada. Planea el mal como una mujer lleva a un bebé en su vientre. \q Planea problemas, y lo que sale son mentiras.

vi.L: Kìa, nó đang chuyển dạ với điều gian ác; nó đã thai nghén điều tai hại và sinh ra sự dối trá.
vi.B: Hãy xem kẻ ác cưu mang điều ác: nó thụ thai điều tai hại và sinh ra sự dối trá.
vi.R: Hãy nhìn kẻ ác. Nó ấp ủ điều ác như người đàn bà mang thai. Nó tính chuyện hại người, và rồi điều nó sinh ra là dối trá.

ko.L: 보아라, 그가 죄악을 낳으려고 진통하고, 재앙을 잉태하여 거짓을 낳았다.
ko.B: 보아라, 악인이 악을 배었다. 재앙을 잉태하더니 거짓을 낳는다.
ko.R: 악한 사람을 보아라. 그는 여자가 아기를 배듯이 악을 품는다. 그는 남을 괴롭힐 일을 꾸미지만, 결국 나오는 것은 거짓뿐이다.

pt.L: Vejam: ele está em dores de parto com a iniquidade; \q concebeu a desgraça e gerou a falsidade.
